correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated Petersen disjoint-pair adjacency, all 252 possible five-vertex cuts, exactly 120 disconnected cuts, and resulting 495 nonempty faces with f=(10,45,120,200,120). Reconstructed deterministic 237-pair Morse matching and verified full directed Hasse DAG (1850 cover relations), leaving 1 vertex, 8 critical 3-simplices and 12 critical 4-simplices. Independently checked the frozen integral 8×12 Morse boundary rank seven and exactly the displayed 7×7 unit minor determinant +1, corroborated with independent full original boundary matrix mod p=2,3,5,7 ranks (9,36,84,115) and reduced Betti (0,0,0,1,5). A finite acyclic matching with no critical 1/2-cells reduces to 3-/4-dimensional CW model; π3(∨8S³)=Z^8 makes the integral attaching-degree matrix complete for homotopy; seven unit pivots cancel and five 4-spheres plus one 3-sphere remain. Nonzero H3 precludes purity-compatible shellability.
